title: Buy the Queen
setup: Your pawn on b7 is one square from queening, and the bishop on d6 is the only piece watching b8.
hint: Nothing on this board matters except the b-file. Which black piece is stopping that pawn?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd6}} is a rook for a bishop, and a bargain: that bishop was the only piece covering b8. Nothing can recapture, so {{b8=Q}} arrives next move. Trade any material you like for a pawn that queens.
